Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI
Seattle, WA / United StatesExperience Transformation & Innovation (XTI) – Agentic Ai /Full-Time /Remote
	APPLY FOR THIS JOB
Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking.  Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies.  We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. 
 
Notice of E-Verify Participation:
 
This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. E-Verify Works for Everyone For more information on E-Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.
 
Right to Work Notice:
 
If you have the skills, experience, and legal right to work, your citizenship or immigration status shouldn’t get in the way. Neither should the place you were born or another aspect of your national origin. A part of U.S. immigration laws protects legally-authorized workers from discrimination based on their citizenship status and national origin. You can read this law at 8 U.S.C. § 1324b. The Immigrant and Employee Rights Section (IER) may be able to help if an employer treats you unfairly in violation of this law. The law that IER enforces is 8 U.S.C. § 1324b. The regulations for this law are at 28 C.F.R. Part 44. Call IER if an employer: Does not hire you or fires you because of your national origin or citizenship status (this may violate a part of the law at 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(1)) Treats you unfairly while checking your right to work in the U.S., including while completing the Form I-9 or using E-Verify (this may violate the law at 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(1) or (a)(6)) Retaliates against you because you are speaking up for your right to work as protected by this law (the law prohibits retaliation at 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(5)) 

Why this role matters 

AI is changing how large organizations operate, and most of our clients are still working out what that means for them. They know the potential is real. What they need is a partner who can connect that potential to their business, prove it quickly, and then make it work at scale. 

Forward Deployed Engineers are central to how we do that. You'll be on the front line of our clients' AI transformation, helping them move from interest and experimentation to AI agents that change how their people work. The work you do shapes what clients believe is possible, which initiatives they invest in, and how successfully those initiatives land. 

For Cprime, this role is also a driver of growth. The trust you build and the results you show are what open the door to larger, longer-term transformation programs. 

About the role 

You'll work where a client's business problem becomes a working AI solution. That spans the full client journey: understanding what the business needs, showing what's possible, and delivering solutions that get used. 

Some of your work will support new business. You'll help prospective clients see the value of agentic AI through fast, focused proofs of value, and your contribution to winning new engagements is a core part of how success in this role is measured. The rest of your work will be billable delivery, where you'll build and deploy solutions as part of a client implementation team. 

The platforms and systems vary by client, so adaptability matters more than deep expertise in any one tool. You'll start alongside senior team members and take on more ownership as you grow. 

Above all, this role is about communication. The best technical build doesn't matter if you can't connect it to the problem the client actually has and explain it in terms they care about. 

What you'll do:

Understand the business 

Work with business and technical stakeholders to understand how they operate and where AI can make the biggest difference 
Translate business challenges into practical technical approaches, and explain the tradeoffs in plain language 
Help clients prioritize the opportunities that will deliver value soonest 

Help win new work 

Quickly build proofs of value that show clients what's possible in their own environment 
Present and demo solutions to audiences ranging from technical teams to executives 
Contribute technical input to proposals, solution designs, and estimates 
Help clients see a clear path from an early win to broader adoption 

Deliver for clients 

Design, build, and integrate AI agents and automations with the systems clients already use 
Take solutions from build through testing, deployment, and early adoption 
Partner with client teams so they can own and extend what we build 

Grow the practice 

Turn what you learn into reusable approaches that make future work faster 
Share lessons from the field with the team, including what didn't work 
What you bring:

Treat this as a description of who we expect you to grow into, not a checklist. If you meet most of it, apply. 

Roughly one to three years in software engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or a related field. Internships, bootcamps, and personal projects count 
Comfortable writing code and working with APIs and integrations 
Hands-on experience building something with AI, at work or on your own 
Strong written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences 
Genuine curiosity about how businesses run, and the ability to connect business problems to technical solutions 
Confidence in client-facing settings, including presenting and asking the hard questions 
Able to move quickly and handle ambiguity without losing quality 
Interest in the commercial side of consulting and how great work leads to new opportunities 
Bonus points, none required:
Experience with enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow or Moveworks 
Background in pre-sales, solutions engineering, or consulting 
A project or demo you can walk us through 
How we will set you up:
You'll work alongside experienced team members on your early engagements 
Paid time and budget for relevant certifications 
A sandbox environment to learn and experiment 
Regular team sessions to share what's working across client engagements 
What good looks like in your first 90 days:
You've made meaningful contributions to client engagements, including at least one that supported new business 
You can build and troubleshoot an integration on your own 
You've presented to a client and handled their follow-up questions 
You've helped the team translate a client's business problem into a proposed solution 
Why this role is worth your time:
AI transformation is one of the biggest shifts large organizations will go through, and few people early in their careers get to help lead it. Here you'll work across many clients, industries, and platforms, and you'll both shape new opportunities and deliver the results. That combination builds real business and technical judgment fast. 
$60,000 - $70,000 a year

Compensation at Cprime varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Cprime provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, and Washington D.C. as set forth above.

Benefits (Salaried employees):

Medical/Vision/Dental: Cprime offers plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield.

Paid Holidays: Cprime provides ten (10) paid standard Holidays.

Paid Time Off or Vacation: Cprime provides up to twenty (20) days of paid time off per year (to be used for both vacation and/or sick time).

Parental Leave: Cprime provides four (4) weeks of paid parental leave if certain eligibility requirements are met.

Retirement Plans: Cprime offers the opportunity to participate in our 401(K) plan. Employees are eligible to enroll thirty (30) days after their official start date. A company match may be offered annually on a discretionary basis if certain eligibility requirements are met.

Other Compensation: Our bonus programs reward our people for their achievements and their contributions to our business. Cprime provides a monthly cell phone stipend and an annual health and wellness stipend to all full-time employees.

 

Benefits (Hourly employees):

Medical/Vision/Dental: Cprime offers plans through Blue Cross Blue Shield.

Sick Leave: Cprime provides the statutory required sick leave depending on the state of residence.

Retirement Plans: Cprime offers the opportunity to participate in our 401(K) plan. Employees are eligible to enroll thirty (30) days after their official start date.

What We Believe In

At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities.  We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement    

Cprime is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
